title: The task
body: Does **[4, 7, 1, 7]** contain a duplicate? We keep a set called `seen` and read the list once.

title: Read 4
body: `seen` is empty, so 4 is new. Add it.

title: Read 7 again
body: 7 **is** in `seen`: we found a duplicate and return true right away. Each check took O(1) time on average, so the whole pass is **O(n) time**, and the set used **O(n) space**.
